service_terms.business_hours: Monday-Friday 09:00-17:00 Africa/Johannesburg, excluding South African public holidays
service_terms.response_clock: Starts only after complete required intake and evidence are received
service_terms.response_target_disclaimer: Business-hour service target, not a guarantee of application outcome, provider decision, funding, admission, employment, or accommodation
service_terms.managed_route_definition: A distinct source-verified opportunity/application pathway with a candidate-specific requirements checklist, evidence/readiness steps, available deadline/source checks, status tracking, and next human-step handoff. Preview, generic guidance, and duplicate listings do not consume a slot. Active slots are concurrent limits and may be reused after a route closes during the service term.
service_terms.accommodation_policy: Accommodation support where relevant consumes one managed-route slot, is subject to verification, availability and consent, and creates no extra route allowance or accommodation fee. Kingsmen does not receive or pay rent/deposits.
service_terms.refund_policy: No AI refund approval. Human review required. Before work starts, requests are eligible for full-refund review subject to applicable law/provider settlement. After work starts or a deliverable is provided, requests are reviewed individually under published terms and applicable South African consumer law. Do not publish a blanket no-refunds claim.
service_terms.cv_revamp_upgrade_condition: A verified prior CV Revamp purchase followed by upgrade to a Kingsmen package adds two concurrent active managed route slots. It is not a cash discount or price credit unless a separate approved promotion states otherwise.
